crossings.note: HBM-P5-RTLB: y_sp = ot_hdc_fsqrt output register y (launch reg) -> side_rest result mux -> lane S mux -> lane E1 flop; the softplus fault OR is registered in ot_hbm_su_static_side_softplus_s (FREG 1). 0 data edges; +1 edge on the softplus fault pulse.

rtl.twin: rtl/hbm_accel/generic/adapters/static_su/top/ot_hbm_su_static_pgslice_lg_s.sv (+ pgslice_s.sv; generated by over_cap_split/gen_pgslice_s.py: PIN_REG default 1 = the plan variant, lanes = ot_hbm_su_static_lane_pinreg leaves); side pipe = rtl/hbm_accel/generic/adapters/static_su/arithmetic/ot_hbm_su_static_side_s.sv (side_softplus core = pinned softplus + fault pin register | side_rest)
rtl.cycle_cost_edges: PIN_REG 1 (existing opt-in, now the plan variant): +2 edges on lane store / RF requests, +4 on lane writes / reducer operands (su_top_compile --pin-reg 1; leaf first_output 36 -> 40 measured); side split: 0 edges on every side DATA result (y_sp is already the fsqrt output flop `y`; only the softplus fault OR was a comb crossing) -> fault pin register: +1 edge on the sqrt(softplus) fault pulse only (status, not scheduled)
rtl.bench: tools/hbm_split/run_pgslice_lg_s_vl.sh OUT QID G SMUT EDGES (Verilator 5.050; tb_hbm_su_pgslice_lg_s: twin pgslice_lg_s PIN_REG 1 vs PINNED pgslice_lg PIN_REG 1, d4g params MLAT 4 ALAT 3 LEAF 1 MULTIRATE 1 COLLPORT 1 RF_LOCAL 1 RSYNC 1, serial 4 / stream 3 lattice, random traffic on every input, 3 resets x 1500 serial edges; every output bit except the sticky fault equal on every serial + stream edge, fault rise <= 1 serial edge later) ; tools/hbm_static/su_lane_leaf_run.sh with SU_PINREG=1 (production lane shape, 31 classes x 64 issues, golden words + SRAM commit readback, outputs on 8 + 28 + 4 PIN_REG edges) ; tools/hbm_split/run_side_s.sh OUT SMUT N SEED (tb_hbm_su_static_side_s: side_s vs pinned side, y identical every edge, fault = rest(t) | softplus(t-1))
rtl.bench_result: ot-gold1 @2ec95b72b SU_PINREG=1 leaf benches: kind0 lane 205 / kind1 lane 133 / kind2 lane 0 PASS (1984 outputs, 3968 checks, first_output 40 = 36 + 4 PIN_REG); mutants ADDR / DATA / PHASE FAIL for kind0 and kind1, DATA / PHASE FAIL for kind2 (kind2 MUT_ADDR passes: pre-existing tb weakness, lane 0's A-row flip reads equal data) ; ot-gold2 @8f38f3246 QID 0 G 0 (FULL lane + side): PASS checks=9000 nonzero_out_edges=8997 fault_checks=4500 resets=3; SMUT 1 (y_sp +1 edge, no re-alignment) FAIL errors=68 (slice_x mismatches) as required ; ot-gold1 @2ec95b72b side_s PASS seed 1 (30300 checks, 11220 side issues, 2899 sqrt(softplus), 222 softplus fault pulses) and seed 7 (11313 / 2800 / 249); SMUT 1 FAIL errors=3565, SMUT 2 (no fault register) FAIL errors=399

note: exp slices: 15 exp lanes + the FULL lane (each with its pinned VM bank: 6 SRAM 128x256), 16 plain lanes 4 per core, side split softplus | rest, reduction pretree.  Lanes need the EXISTING opt-in PIN_REG=1 (lane_pinreg leaf; the views use PIN_REG 0): +2 edges on store/RF requests, +4 on writes/reducer operands (su_top_compile --pin-reg).
